prompt:
USE: A flat game decal for a sign on a workshop wall in a clockmaker's town square. Straight-on orthographic view, no perspective. The sign fills the frame.
SUBJECT: A rectangular board of three weathered dark timber planks held by two dark iron straps with round rivets. Hand-painted off-white capitals, a little faded, in two lines, centred. Line 1: "WORKSHOP" in large letters. Line 2: "GEARS & SPRINGS" in smaller letters.
TEXT RULES: Draw exactly these two lines, once each, and no other text. Spelling: W-O-R-K-S-H-O-P; G-E-A-R-S, an ampersand, S-P-R-I-N-G-S.
STYLE: Photographic realism with restraint. Weathered timber with open grain, flaking paint, dark iron with a satin finish. Soft, even, shadowless light from all sides. No mirror reflections, no glow, so the colours read as base colour.
CONSTRAINTS: Fully transparent background outside the sign, with a crisp edge and no halo. Do not draw a checkerboard, a backdrop, a wall or a drop shadow. No people, no extra signs. No logos, no watermarks. Original design only.
